name: Converter
helpText: Implement the required transformation in the generated converter class. Configure its source and target Java types through the component properties.

conversionRecipes.helpText: Extracts common JMS message bodies into an Ikasan DefaultPayload and supplies the filename required by FTP and SFTP producers.

conversionRecipes.displayName: Auto-converted JMS content to FTP/SFTP Payload
conversionRecipes.helpText: Wraps the body already extracted by the JMS consumer in an Ikasan DefaultPayload and supplies the filename required by FTP and SFTP producers.
Extracts the body of common JMS message types and uses it as the body of an Ikasan EmailPayload.

conversionRecipes.displayName: Auto-converted JMS content to Email Payload
conversionRecipes.helpText: Uses the body already extracted by the JMS consumer as the body of an Ikasan EmailPayload.
Extracts the raw bytes from an FTP/SFTP Payload for producers (e.g. JMS) that accept byte[] content.

allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

fromType.helpText: The type of data we expect to come into the converter, e.g. java.lang.Object or java.lang.String - enter just the plain class name. If the upstream component's own Output: text ends with an annotation like '(auto-converted)', that's an explanatory note, not part of the type - do not paste it in here.
fromType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the input to the converter.

toType.helpText: The type of data we expect to be the output of the converter. This can be any Java class.
toType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the output of the converter.

requiresStub.helpText: Does this component require a stub to be generated by Studio, if not, it is assumed the user will provide the instance from its own factory class.

userImplementedClassName.helpText: The name of the class that contain the custom conversion, the IDE will create a template for this class, the user  must provide the implementation.
userImplementedClassName.validationMessage: Provide a valid java classname for the converter e.g. starting with upper case, followed by number/characters etc.

configuration.helpText: Provide the bean type that contains bespoke configurations for this component.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID is moduleName + flowName + componentName + componentType. Override it when multiple flows should share a configuration, or when renaming a flow without changing configuration already stored in the override-properties database.
